mapper.select: select id, title, content, category, source, source_url, cover_image, status, publish_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time from t_authority_info where id = #{id}

select id, title, content, category, source, source_url, cover_image, status, publish_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time from t_authority_info where status = 1 and category = #{category} and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by publish_time desc

select id, title, content, category, source, source_url, cover_image, status, publish_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time from t_authority_info where status = 1 order by publish_time desc limit 100
select id, title, content, category, source, source_url, cover_image, status, publish_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time from t_authority_info order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into t_authority_info(title, content, category, source, source_url, cover_image, status, publish_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{source}, #{sourceUrl}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{publishTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
